name: Gibbering Mouther

traits.name: Aberrant Ground
traits.desc: The ground within 10 feet of the mouther is Difficult Terrain. A creature that starts its turn there makes a DC 10 Strength save or has Speed 0 until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Gibbering
traits.desc: While the mouther can see, creatures within 20 feet that can hear it can't take Reactions and act erratically on a failed DC 10 Wisdom save.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Blinding Spittle
actions.desc: The mouther spits at a point within 15 feet; creatures within 5 feet of it make a DC 13 Dexterity save or are Blinded until the end of the mouther's next turn.

desc: A shapeless heap of eyes and mouths that never stop muttering. Its voices pull at the mind; the ground around it turns to sucking mud.
